def _parse_address_groups(self, scope: PANScope, search_root: ET.Element, extraction: ExtractionResult):
        ir = extraction.canonical_ir
        paths = ["./address-group/entry"] if scope.kind == "vsys" else ["./shared/address-group/entry"]
        for path in paths:
            for g_entry in search_root.findall(path):
                g_name = g_entry.get("name")
                if not g_name:
                    continue
                desc_elem = g_entry.find("description")
                desc = desc_elem.text if desc_elem is not None else None

                dyn_filter_elem = g_entry.find("./dynamic/filter")
                if dyn_filter_elem is not None:
                    extraction.inventory_items.append(SourceInventoryItem(
                        domain="address_groups",
                        source_path=f"address-group/entry[@name='{g_name}']",
                        name=g_name,
                        status=ExtractionStatus.EXTRACT_ONLY,
                        requires_manual_review=True,
                        notes=[f"Dynamic address group with filter: {dyn_filter_elem.text.strip() if dyn_filter_elem.text else ''}"]
                    ))
                    continue

                members = [m.text for m in g_entry.findall("./static/member") if m.text]
                ir.address_groups.append(IRAddressGroup(
                    name=g_name,
                    members=members,
                    description=desc
                ))

    def _parse_tags(self, scope: PANScope, search_root: ET.Element, extraction: ExtractionResult):
        paths = ["./tag/entry"] if scope.kind == "vsys" else ["./shared/tag/entry"]
        for path in paths:
            for t_entry in search_root.findall(path):
                t_name = t_entry.get("name")
                if not t_name:
                    continue
                color_elem = t_entry.find("color")
                color = color_elem.text if color_elem is not None else ""
                comments_elem = t_entry.find("comments")
                comments = comments_elem.text if comments_elem is not None else ""
                extraction.inventory_items.append(SourceInventoryItem(
                    domain="tags",
                    source_path=f"tag/entry[@name='{t_name}']",
                    name=t_name,
                    status=ExtractionStatus.EXTRACT_ONLY,
                    requires_manual_review=False,
                    notes=[f"Tag color: {color}, comments: {comments}"]
                ))
